findings.note: The Nov 3 VSiN preview says Michkov leads the Flyers with 10 goals and makes him a pick for anytime goal (+235) against Minnesota; that is a goals pick, not an assists pick, and his scoring so far leans toward goals.

This September camp report says Michkov came in about 30 pounds lighter, aiming for a bigger role; it calls playmaking his best asset and notes 15 assists in 26 games after the Olympic break last season.
Michkov scored twice with no assists at MSG on Feb 26, 2026; the source is old and doesn't show current lines or availability for the Nov 5 game.
